L4 | 60 = 1 x 60, 2 x 30, 3 x 20, 4 x 15, 5 x 12, 6 x 10 ; 60 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, (15), 20, 30, 60
L5 | = 15.15
reasoning: The student lists factors and takes the common factor 15 (the FPB) instead of the KPK 180 minutes, answering 15.15 instead of 12.15.
Q1 = 12 and Q3 = 16 are right, but the IQR is computed with the quartile-deviation formula (Q3 - Q1)/2 and then miscalculated as 14/2 = 7 instead of 16 - 12 = 4.
